description: This source file defines the ContentSearch class which provides methods and inner classes for performing content searches within the OFBiz framework. It includes search constraints such as content associations, keywords, and last updated date ranges, as well as result sorting options. The class interacts with entities like Content, ContentAssoc, and ContentKeyword to build dynamic queries and retrieve content identifiers based on various search criteria.

classes.name: ContentSearch
classes.description: Main class providing content search functionalities including search execution and various search constraints and sorting options.

classes.name: ContentSearch.ContentSearchContext
classes.description: Inner class encapsulating the state and methods necessary for constructing and executing a content search, including managing constraints, result ordering, and query execution.

classes.name: ContentSearch.ContentSearchConstraint
classes.description: Abstract base class for defining different types of search constraints, such as content associations and keywords.

classes.name: ContentSearch.ContentAssocConstraint
classes.description: Constraint class to filter content based on association relationships, optionally including sub-contents.

classes.name: ContentSearch.KeywordConstraint
classes.description: Constraint class that filters content based on keywords, supporting logical AND/OR combinations, prefix/suffix matching, and stem removal.

classes.name: ContentSearch.LastUpdatedRangeConstraint
classes.description: Constraint specifying a date range for last modification timestamps of the content.

classes.name: ContentSearch.ResultSortOrder
classes.description: Abstract class for defining sorting order of search results, with implementations for relevancy sorting and content field sorting.

classes.name: ContentSearch.SortKeywordRelevancy
classes.description: Sorting order based on keyword relevance, primarily by total relevancy score.

classes.name: ContentSearch.SortContentField
classes.description: Sorting order based on a specific content field, with options for ascending or descending order.

methods.name: searchContents
methods.description: Static method to perform a content search given a list of constraints, sort order, delegator, and visit ID, returning list of content IDs.

methods.name: getAllSubContentIds
methods.description: Recursive method to gather all sub-content IDs of a given content ID, considering content associations and effective dates.
